title: Potatoism Planetary Cosmology — Sun, Center, Earth, Moon, Saturn, Door and North
purpose: Integrate the project's Sun/Spudlight, Earth/embodiment, Moon/reflection, Dog/Farmer, Saturn/enclosure, Door/Vesica and Center/Axis ideas into one dense comparative cosmology. The layer distinguishes real astronomy, historical celestial symbolism and Potatoverse theology while making the relational structure explicit.
epistemic_rule: Astronomical facts describe the physical Sun, Earth, Moon and Saturn. Historical traditions describe their own gods, symbols and cosmologies. Potatoverse mappings such as Tim=Sun/Spudlight/Center, Dog=Moon, Farmer follows Moon, or Son=Door are internal symbolic/theological relations unless separately supported as historical claims. Similarity is useful; it is not proof of supernatural identity.

central_thesis.project_form: Tim/Father is increasingly the source-center and illuminating/orienting pole; Sun is the strongest physical-symbolic comparator for emitted light and centrality; Spudlight is the project-specific principle of illumination/revelation; Earth is embodiment/soil/world; Moon is reflected/cyclical/mediating light; Son/Christ/Thomas/Vessel occupies the Door or overlap where fields meet; Dogs and Farmers are responsive roles that can follow secondary signals, cycles, masters and boundaries.
central_thesis.compact_chain: Source/Tim → Sun/Spudlight → {direct illumination of Earth | reflected illumination through Moon} → Eye/observer → Door/state change
central_thesis.shadow_chain: Source signal → reflector/proxy → Dog/Farmer follows proxy → enclosure/phase loop → reflector mistaken for source
central_thesis.healthy_chain: Source → faithful reflection → timing/orientation → guardian/cultivator acts → Door opens toward greater autonomy/life
central_thesis.key_insight: Reflected light is not false merely because it is reflected. The decisive question is whether the reflector preserves orientation to the source or becomes mistaken for the source/master itself.

center_taxonomy.why_needed: The project repeatedly calls Tim 'center', but center has several distinct mathematical, astronomical and symbolic meanings. Keeping them separate prevents Sun, Door, Axis and Vesica from competing for one undifferentiated point.

types.definition: origin/reference from which a field, signal or orientation is generated
types.potatoverse: Tim/Father/Spudlight source-center; center of the upper/source circle

types.definition: point fixed by symmetry of a geometric object
types.potatoverse: circle center or midpoint of the Vesica construction; purely geometric unless mapped

types.definition: point/region created by relation between complete domains rather than belonging exclusively to one
types.potatoverse: Vesica/Mandorla overlap and its midpoint; especially appropriate to Son/Door/interface

types.definition: center of mass/barycenter about which interacting bodies move
types.astronomy: Sun dominates solar-system mass, but the exact solar-system barycenter moves and can lie near the Sun's center or outside its surface

types.definition: reference by which positions/directions are organized
types.potatoverse: Axis/North/Tim as reference frame; North of North as meta-reference testing the orientation

types.definition: observer-centered coordinate origin or apparent center of a local sky/model
types.example: Earth-centered sky descriptions can be observationally useful without Earth being the solar-system barycenter

types.potatoverse: Tim as center of a long-running public/archival relational field

center_taxonomy.rule: Never infer physical centrality from theological centrality. Instead record which center-type a claim means.

facts: The Sun is a G-type main-sequence star about 4.5 billion years old and the dominant mass in the solar system.
Its gravity organizes planetary, asteroid and cometary motion in the solar system.
The exact dynamical center is the solar-system barycenter, which changes with planetary configuration; the Sun itself moves around this barycenter.
The Sun and solar system orbit the center of the Milky Way on a timescale of roughly 230 million years.

sun.tim_mapping: Within Potatoverse canon Tim can be called Sun-like because Tim occupies the source/orienting/illuminating role. The useful statement is functional: Tim-as-Sun is a source-center metaphor and Spudlight emitter/revealer in project theology, not the astronomical claim that the human Tim is the physical star.
sun.center_importance: Sun imagery is especially powerful because the physical Sun combines source, radiance and near-central dynamical dominance. These three properties map onto three different project functions—Spudlight/source, visibility/revelation, and center/orientation—and should be recorded separately.
sun.spudlight_relation: Sunlight is real electromagnetic radiation; Spudlight is the project's broader expression/revelation principle. Physical sunlight is one comparator/implementation example, not the whole meaning of Spudlight.
sun.biology_relation: Solar energy enters terrestrial ecosystems; photosynthesis stores part of incident light energy chemically, and potato plants later allocate carbohydrates into tubers. This gives the project a literal Sun→life→starch-storage chain beside the symbolic Sun→Spudlight→Potato chain.
sun.historical_mesopotamia: Mesopotamian Utu/Šamaš is a solar deity represented by solar-disc imagery and associated with justice/seeing; this is a historically separate tradition but a useful comparator for Sun + Eye + judgment/illumination.

facts: Earth orbits the Sun in about 365.25 days
Earth's axial tilt is about 23.4 degrees and is central to seasons
sunlight reaches Earth in roughly eight minutes

earth.important_upgrade: Earth is not a passive lower circle. It rotates, orbits, tilts, receives, stores and transforms incoming energy. Symbolically this means manifestation is active: world/body/soil does not merely receive Source but metabolizes it.
earth.potato_relation: Earth supplies the literal soil, minerals, water, temperature regime and biological context in which Potato can grow. Thus Earth is the transformation medium between incoming solar energy and stored tuber capacity.
earth.observer_relation: Moon phases are what an Earth observer sees from changing Sun–Moon–Earth geometry. This makes Earth not only embodiment but the observation point from which reflected light acquires a visible phase.

facts: The Moon does not generate visible moonlight; it reflects sunlight.
Half the Moon is illuminated by the Sun at any instant, while the illuminated fraction visible from Earth changes with geometry.
The synodic phase cycle is about 29.5 days; orbital revolution is about 27.3 days.
The Moon is tidally locked so approximately the same hemisphere faces Earth.
The Moon is the largest contributor to Earth's tides because of its proximity; Sun–Moon alignments amplify spring tides, while quarter-phase geometry produces neap tides.

moon.reflection_law: The physically grounded chain is Sun → Moon reflection → Earth observer. The Moon therefore supplies an unusually clean model of derived illumination: the source is elsewhere, yet the reflected light is real and useful.
moon.project_epiphany: Moon symbolism is strongest when treated as transformed/phase-dependent access to source-light, not as a competing independent source. The Moon can reveal the Sun at night while also hiding the direct source relation if the reflector is mistaken for origin.
moon.phase_as_configuration: What is seen is relational. Moon phase is not an intrinsic changing quantity of lunar luminosity but an observer-dependent geometry among Sun, Moon and Earth. This is a strong physical comparator for the project's Door principle: some states become visible or accessible only under a particular configuration of relations.
moon.tide_as_modulation: The Moon does not merely reflect light; together with the Sun it participates gravitationally in tide patterns. Symbolically, Moon can therefore carry both reflection and modulation: secondary bodies can strongly shape rhythms even when they are not the original source of light/energy.
moon.moon_to_mud_archaeology: Older project language 'Moon turns Swamp into Mud' can now be interpreted provisionally as reflection/cycle causing diffuse unresolved material to reappear, settle or become structured. This remains an interpretive hypothesis until the original intended mechanism is recovered.

dog_farmer_moon_master.status: Potatoverse role model; not a claim that real persons are controlled by the Moon
dog_farmer_moon_master.core: Dogs and Farmers can overlap because both are responsive roles. Dog follows/tracks/guards a master or boundary; Farmer follows seasons, cycles, weather and harvest timing. Moon provides a compact symbol for reflected authority plus cyclical timing.
dog_farmer_moon_master.dog: Dog is especially suited to Moon-following symbolism when it is the tracker, guardian, patrol or pack node responding to a signal rather than originating the system's highest orientation.
dog_farmer_moon_master.farmer: Farmer is especially suited to lunar/cyclical symbolism when it is the timing/calendrical/harvest operator that reads signs and works under recurring limits. Historical agricultural calendars sometimes used lunar or lunisolar cycles, but no universal Farmer=Moon doctrine is claimed.
dog_farmer_moon_master.overlap: A Farmer-Dog both structures/maintains an enclosure and actively patrols or enforces it; both can follow the same secondary signal/master representation.
dog_farmer_moon_master.master_problem: The key distinction is Source versus proxy. A master can be the actual orienting source, or a local owner/platform/authority whose signal is reflected through a proxy. In healthy relation the reflector points beyond itself; in shadow relation the proxy becomes an idol/enclosure and the follower loses access to source.
dog_farmer_moon_master.josh_moon_boundary: The surname Moon can be used as Potatoverse wordplay/symbolic coupling around Josh Moon/Farm, but it is not evidence of lunar causation or occult identity. Any real claim about Joshua Moon remains attached to documented platform actions rather than name symbolism.
dog_farmer_moon_master.formal_social_analogy: Y_reflected = R(context,phase)·X_source + noise; follower acts on Y_reflected rather than direct X_source. This is an archive-generated communication analogy, not physical moonlight controlling behavior.

door_and_alignment.core: Door becomes more precise when treated as configuration-dependent accessibility. A boundary may exist continuously while passage/visibility depends on alignment among source, mediator and receiver.
door_and_alignment.lunar_comparator: Moon phase demonstrates that relation can create an observable state: source illumination + lunar surface + observer geometry → visible phase.
door_and_alignment.timic_chain: Tim/Source/Spudlight → Moon/reflector or other mediator → Earth/observer → Eye → recognition → Door → changed state
door_and_alignment.shadow_chain: reflector/proxy becomes mistaken for source → follower loops around secondary center → Door remains unrecognized or becomes enclosure
door_and_alignment.alignment_concept: Alignment should be typed: geometric, attentional, covenantal, psychological, institutional or symbolic. Never collapse these into one physical force.

vesica_and_centers.two_domains: In the standard two-circle construction, each circle has its own center. If upper/source circle is mapped to Father/Tim/Sun and lower/embodied circle to Earth/humanity/Son-side manifestation, the overlap is a third relational region rather than the center of either parent circle.
three_center_problem: C_R = midpoint between circle centers / center of the lens relation
vesica_and_centers.recommended_mapping: Tim/Father/Sun most naturally occupies C_F as source-center and can also function as the orientational center of the broader coordinate system. Son/Door most naturally occupies the shared lens/relational region. Earth/humanity occupies the embodied circle. This preserves identity-to-infrastructure without making Father and Door geometrically identical.
vesica_and_centers.axis: The perpendicular bisector through the circle intersections is the natural symmetry Axis of the lens. Its crossing with the line between parent-circle centers marks C_R, the relational center.
vesica_and_centers.important_distinction: Tim can be 'center' without being every geometrical center. Source-center, relational center and Axis-reference are different functions. The project should say which is meant each time.
vesica_and_centers.center_of_center: North of North can then be read as meta-orientation: not another geometric point but the criterion by which the whole coordinate/orientation system is judged.

vesica_geometry.note: The earlier archive value ~0.6141848r² was half the full lens area and has been corrected in the canonical geometry file.
vesica_geometry.center_coordinates: For circle centers (-r/2,0) and (r/2,0), relational/lens center is (0,0), intersections are (0,±sqrt(3)r/2).

mesopotamian_comparators.sun_moon: Mesopotamian art can place the solar symbol of Šamaš and lunar crescent of Sîn alongside other celestial divine symbols. This gives a real historical example of Sun and Moon as differentiated sacred signs rather than one undifferentiated light.
mesopotamian_comparators.sun_eye_judgment: Šamaš/Utu's solar/seeing/justice field is a useful historical comparator to project Sun→Eye→judgment/illumination, while remaining independent of Potatoverse genealogy.
mesopotamian_comparators.ox_eye_vesica: Mathematical reconstruction of the Old Babylonian 'ox-eye' or bull's-eye figure yields the geometry now called a vesica piscis. This is an especially interesting Mesopotamia↔Eye↔Vesica mathematical neighbor, but it does not show that Babylonians held the Potatoverse Door theology.

saturn.role: boundary / time / constraint / harvest / outer classical planetary limit
saturn.astronomical: Saturn is a gas giant with rings and a persistent north-polar hexagonal jet pattern.
saturn.project: Saturn remains the strong boundary/enclosure/timing pole. Positive Saturn preserves and disciplines; shadow Saturn traps and hardens. Farmer is Saturnian when working timing, storage and harvest; it becomes shadow-Farm when those same capacities maximize extraction/dependency.
saturn.ring_spiral: Ring = recurrence around an enclosure; Spiral = recurrence plus changed level/escape/learning. This preserves the useful Saturn↔Spiral polarity.
saturn.north_relation: The actual Saturn north-pole hexagon supplies a concrete astronomy anchor for Saturn+North+boundary, but no ancient occult foreknowledge is inferred.

system_equations_and_analogies.source_reflector_receiver: Y_E = T_SE X_S + T_ME R_M(geometry,albedo) X_S + N
system_equations_and_analogies.meaning: Receiver/Earth can receive direct source signal plus a transformed reflected path through Moon; symbolic/social models may reuse the graph form but not the physical units.
system_equations_and_analogies.meaning_center: Physical barycenter depends on masses/positions; project source-center depends on role/ontology. The distinction is essential.
system_equations_and_analogies.meaning_door: Door accessibility can depend on alignment/configuration rather than the Door appearing/disappearing as an object.
system_equations_and_analogies.meaning_reflection: Useful for comparing faithful mediation with proxy capture; must be defined per domain before quantification.

deep_findings: Tim-as-Center is not redundant with Tim-as-Sun. Sun adds source/radiance; Center adds reference/organization; Spudlight adds revelation/transmission; Axis adds orientation. Together they form a source-center complex.

Moon is best modeled as derivative yet consequential: it has no independent visible light source, but reflected light, orbital geometry and gravity strongly affect Earth experience. This makes it an excellent symbol for secondary authority, mirror, cycle and modulation.

Dogs and Farmers overlap as followers/readers of signals. Dog follows master/boundary; Farmer follows timing/season/incentive. Moon unifies the secondary-signal and cycle dimensions without making either role inherently evil.
A reflector can serve the source or replace the source. This is the deeper moral distinction behind healthy guardian/cultivator versus shadow proxy/enforcer.
Vesica has multiple centers. Keeping Father/source center distinct from Son/Door relational center resolves a hidden ambiguity in earlier diagrams.
Earth is not merely 'below'; it is the metabolizing world that turns incoming light into life, work, memory, starch and future seed.

The center of a real gravitational system is relational (barycentric) rather than simply the geometric center of its brightest object. This supports a mature project distinction between being the main organizing source and being the exact mathematical center of every relation.

Mesopotamia unexpectedly supplies two independent comparators: differentiated Sun/Moon divine imagery and an Old Babylonian ox-eye geometry matching the vesica construction. Neither establishes Potatoverse historical transmission, but both enrich the comparative map.
research_targets: Recover exact primary Tim statements saying Tim is Sun, center, light or Spudlight, and date each independently.
Recover exact conversation wording for Dogs/Farmers following Moon/master/Door and distinguish Josh Moon wordplay from lunar cosmology.
Map every use of center in the archive to center taxonomy: source, geometric, relational, dynamical, orientational, observational or attention-center.
Determine whether the canonical upper/lower Vesica mapping fixes Tim at upper center and Son in lens, or whether older diagrams used a different mapping.
Build a phase/alignment visualization only if it remains explicit that astronomy is comparator, not metaphysical proof.
Connect Sun→plant→starch→Potato to the existing Starchforce/Spudlight storage-release model with real biological units kept separate from symbolic ones.
